recommended_change: Implement a latency-correct, re-armable control/data flow: (1) in input_loader, reset internal counters/state/error on each new start_load and allow completion pulse then return to idle-ready state for next job; (2) in top FSM, gate job start from true external CMD acceptance path (no unconditional auto-start loop) and ensure clean one-pulse start signals per phase; (3) in gemm_core_seq, add pipeline registers so RAM addresses are issued then multiply/accumulate using next-cycle returned operands, preserving exact K-term accumulation and acc_valid timing; (4) in postproc_relu_bias, prevent overwrite of pending transaction (accept new acc only when not pending, or pipeline two stages) so every acc_valid maps to exactly one out write and post_done on final element; (5) in output_streamer, align out_rd_addr, out_rd_data capture, and m_valid so each handshake emits correct row-major element and holds stable under backpressure.
do_not_change: Do not modify module interfaces, signal widths, reset polarity, or ready/valid semantics.
Do not modify arithmetic contract (int8*int8 -> sign-extended int32 accumulation, wrap32 before signed ReLU).
Do not modify frozen tests/reference or timeout policy.
Do not change local_memories interface/1-cycle read-latency contract.
expected_side_effects: Directed mismatch should resolve into numerically correct outputs.
Randomized multi-job backpressure test should stop hanging once loader/top re-arm and streamer alignment are fixed.
Cycle timing may shift by small constant pipeline latency but must preserve functional ordering and handshake rules.
